g.text: Colors, text, corners, spacing, shadow, motion and icons. Inter only. Google Material Symbols Rounded, weight 300.

svg.text: No uppercase labels. No letter spacing tricks. Sentence case everywhere.
Only menus, dialogs, toasts and the upload
panel. Cards use a border, no shadow.
